description: Retail mapping software for CRE brokers: drop 1,000+ official brand logos onto a map and export branded, print-ready PDFs and 4K PNGs for offering memorandums, lease proposals, and flyers.
pricing: $39/month or $379/year. Free to start, no credit card required.
notes: Built for retail brokers who need presentation-quality trade area maps fast. Auto-find nearby tenants by category, drag logos into titled groups, connect them with leader lines, and export to branded PDF templates or 4K PNG. Not a GIS platform: it replaces the hour spent in PowerPoint after the analysis is done.
